question: Can merged calibrated ANS results reuse all fixed virtual products without repeated decode and meet a 120 Hz presentation budget?

code.source_state: Dirty development checkouts; private patches and native GPU file hashes retained. App patch covers this integration, not unrelated pre-existing edits. No release qualification.

parameters.representation: ANS regional scaled uint16; restored float32 reductions
parameters.first_run: shared-products passed all product/display gates; 35/36 product and 9/10 DP timing receipts captured. Timing qualification incomplete.
parameters.repeat: shared-products-repeat failed the added complete-receipt gate; all product and image hash checks passed. Failure retained.
parameters.correction: Reuse bounded shared float-canvas presentation confirmation; assign each scientific image a presentation ID; configure initial contrast and palette before publishing the surface. Never treat zero drawable presentation time as visible.
parameters.intermediate: shared-products-confirmed captured all 36 product receipts but only 9/10 DP receipts; retained as failed. Configure-before-publication fixed the remaining first-DP receipt on the final run.
parameters.parity: 520-frame two-calibration-region independent Double reference; scalar/batch bit equality; zero-total/signed normalization; cancellation. Signed near-zero mask uses seven-operation float32 forward-error bound; positive mask tolerance unchanged. Maximum signed near-zero relative error 2.765655517578125e-05 is within that bound, not a universal relative-tolerance claim.

display_latency_ms.definition: Native-hook request to positive CAMetalDrawable presentedTime; isolated requests, not continuous FPS or cold I/O

fresh_merge.scope: Same product calculations before the final presentation-only fixes; initial folder/comparison loading excluded.

parameters.limits: 120 Hz is not established and the measured isolated latency exceeds 8.33 ms. No arbitrary merged-detector dragging, full XCTest, EMPAD/SSB regression, cold-I/O or distribution signoff. Fixed detector defaults are geometric; existing DPC orientation uses small 2D CPU work. Scaled uint16 intensity conversion is approximate; ANS codes exact.

artifact_results.shared-ui: Passed all nine products over 36 selections, eight hover/restores, all 15 colormaps, live percentile previews, ten DP positions, complete presentation receipts, regular-viewer restoration and clean quit. No 120 FPS claim.
artifact_results.fresh-merge: Full seven-acquisition merge, cancellation/retry, nine cached products, scan changes and regular comparison restoration passed. Mean matches the saved result exactly; 7 single-read sources; no crop/bin/clip.
artifact_results.receipt-failure: Retained failed repeat: all scientific/display checks passed, but only 35/36 product and 9/10 DP presentation receipts.
artifact_results.first-dp-failure: Retained intermediate failure: 36/36 product and 9/10 DP receipts. Superseded by passing configure-before-publication run, not deleted.
artifact_results.adf-screenshot: Actual native merged ADF and DP populated; visually reviewed with light-mode and iDPC captures. Percentile saturation is intentional in this 25-75 percent test.
